package personalteacher

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"strings"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain/repository"
)

// Ensure creates the student's logical teacher once and returns the canonical record.
type Ensure struct {
	Teachers repository.PersonalTeacher
	IDs      IDGenerator
	Clock    Clock
}

// Execute ensures a PersonalTeacher exists for studentID.
func (uc Ensure) Execute(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.PersonalTeacher, error) {
	studentID = strings.TrimSpace(studentID)
	if studentID == "" || uc.Teachers == nil || uc.IDs == nil || uc.Clock == nil {
		return domain.PersonalTeacher{}, errors.New("invalid ensure personal teacher request")
	}
	now := uc.Clock.Now()
	teacher, err := domain.NewPersonalTeacher(
		uc.IDs.NewID(),
		studentID,
		domain.DefaultPersonalTeacherSettings(),
		now,
	)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PersonalTeacher{}, err
	}
	soul, err := domain.NewTeacherSoul(
		teacher.ID, teacher.StudentID, domain.DefaultTeacherSoulSettings(), now,
	)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PersonalTeacher{}, err
	}
	storedTeacher, _, err := uc.Teachers.Ensure(ctx, teacher, soul)
	return storedTeacher, err
}
